summary: OctoBot is a self-hosted application designed for automated cryptocurrency trading. It enables users to execute programmatic financial strategies across various digital asset exchanges using a containerised runtime environment.
goodFor: It suits technical users who want to run automated cryptocurrency trading strategies on their own infrastructure under the GPL-3.0 licence.
watchOut: Automated financial trading carries inherent risks of capital loss through misconfigured strategies or unexpected market volatility, and self-hosted trading bots require constant connection to external exchange APIs.
deployNotes: As a Python application packaged for Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for configuration and logs, along with a reverse proxy if you expose a web interface.
